_comment: M4C Sentinel-1 date-level preprocessing parameters. Changing ANY value here changes the run signature, so stale outputs are detected and never silently reused. Preprocessing only: no flood classification, no baseline designation, no validation.

resampling.intermediate_10m: slice -> UTM 44N 10 m lattice aligned to the master grid (nearest neighbour, geometric only), linear power
resampling.to_30m: exact 3x3 block mean of linear power (reduceResolution mean), then 10*log10 -> dB

applied_by_collection_per_catalog_page: terrain correction (SRTM 30 m; ASTER above 60 deg latitude)
earth_engine_processing_claims.border_noise_removal: NOT confirmed from the catalog page text; checked empirically (edge/seam diagnostics), not assumed
earth_engine_processing_claims.radiometric_terrain_flattening: NOT applied and NOT claimed (ellipsoid-based terrain correction only)
earth_engine_processing_claims.incidence_angle: angle band is ~20 km pixels (approximate); NOT used to normalise backscatter in M4C
earth_engine_processing_claims.not_repeated_here: no extra calibration, noise removal or terrain correction is applied
